title: Implement catalog_preview_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_preview_cache.py for project catalog-api using the component API in README.md.

The component must export:
- POLICY: the complete approved nested policy from the standing catalog-api response-cache agreement
- SOURCE and RATIONALE: the exact named approval fields
- create_cache(clock): returns a working ResponseCache governed by that policy

Apply the current standing response-cache agreement retained at key catalog-api/response-cache (v2, CACHE-18). Recall that key to get the full approved policy before implementing. The relevant agreement is the current one (not the v1 snapshot); it governs all new catalog reader components.

Add a test file tests/test_catalog_preview_cache.py covering policy values, SOURCE/RATIONALE presence, cache hit/miss, TTL expiry, FIFO eviction, and namespaced keys. Preserve all earlier components and project history. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests to verify.
